name: Desktop World Clocks
description:
Keep the times that matter visible on your GNOME desktop.

Desktop World Clocks places customizable, click-through world clocks above your wallpaper and below application windows. Check the local time for teammates, customers, friends, or family without opening another application or calculating time-zone differences.

* Create up to four independent groups with ten clocks each
* Choose any installed time zone and customize names, fonts, colors, opacity, layouts, corners, monitors, and backgrounds
* Use 12- or 24-hour time, optional seconds, date differences, and per-clock colors or abbreviations
* Uses your existing system clock and time synchronization service
* Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry

Supports GNOME Shell 49, 50, and 51.
